svg.text: Lid Hall sensor: lid open → wake buds
The case has its own battery, a charger and a
small controller. It tops the buds up through
two pogo pins, reports its own level to the
buds, and tells them when the lid opens so
they can wake and reconnect. That is why
Earshot can show a case battery at all: the
buds relay what the case told them.
The case is a computer too
